```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
#data <- read.csv("sim_summary_all_combined.csv")
data <- read.csv("sim_summary_1122.csv")
skew <- read.csv("sim_summary_skew_combined.csv")
skew_confounder <- read.csv("sim_summary_skew_confounder_combined.csv")
head(data)
head(skew)
head(skew_confounder)

## --- 1. Build matching keys for each dataset ---

key_data_no  <- with(data, type == "skew" & confounder == "no")
key_data_yes <- with(data, type == "skew" & confounder == "yes")

# Character keys for matching
k_data_no  <- with(data[key_data_no, ],  paste(n1, n2, delta0, rep_id, sep = "_"))
k_data_yes <- with(data[key_data_yes, ], paste(n1, n2, delta0, rep_id, sep = "_"))

k_skew  <- with(skew,            paste(n1, n2, delta0, rep_id, sep = "_"))
k_skewc <- with(skew_confounder, paste(n1, n2, delta0, rep_id, sep = "_"))

# Indices in skew / skew_confounder that correspond to each data row
m_no  <- match(k_data_no,  k_skew)
m_yes <- match(k_data_yes, k_skewc)

## Safety check (optional)
if (any(is.na(m_no)))  warning("Some no-confounder skew rows did not find a match in `skew`.")
if (any(is.na(m_yes))) warning("Some yes-confounder skew rows did not find a match in `skew_confounder`.")


## --- 2. Replace columns for confounder == "no", type == "skew" using `skew` ---

idx_no <- which(key_data_no)

data$p_wilcox[idx_no]  <- skew$p_wilcox[m_no]
data$p_ttest[idx_no]   <- skew$p_ttest[m_no]
data$p_ks[idx_no]      <- skew$p_ks[m_no]
data$p_deshape[idx_no] <- skew$p_deshape[m_no]
# For the no-confounder skew case, glm/deconfounder columns can stay NA


## --- 3. Replace columns for confounder == "yes", type == "skew" using `skew_confounder` ---

idx_yes <- which(key_data_yes)

data$p_wilcox[idx_yes]                 <- skew_confounder$p_wilcox[m_yes]
data$p_ttest[idx_yes]                  <- skew_confounder$p_ttest[m_yes]
data$p_ks[idx_yes]                     <- skew_confounder$p_ks[m_yes]
data$p_deshape[idx_yes]                <- skew_confounder$p_deshape[m_yes]
data$p_deshape_glm[idx_yes]            <- skew_confounder$p_deshape_glm[m_yes]
data$p_ks_glm[idx_yes]                 <- skew_confounder$p_ks_glm[m_yes]
data$p_deshape_deconfounder[idx_yes]   <- skew_confounder$p_deshape_deconfounder[m_yes]

## Done: `data` now has skew results plugged in from the two combined datasets.

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

## -----------------------------
## 0. Setup
## -----------------------------
# significance level
alpha <- 0.05

# color palette for sample size
n_colors <- c(
  "10"  = "#6090c1",
  "30"  = "#acd2e5",
  "50"  = "#fef9b7",
  "70"  = "#fee395",
  "90"  = "#f2724d",
  "110" = "#d7312d"
)

## -----------------------------
## 1. Reshape data to long format
## -----------------------------
data_long <- data %>%
  mutate(n = n1) %>%   
  filter(n < 120) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  # keep only non-NA p-values
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  # remove "p_" prefix from method name
  mutate(method = str_remove(method, "^p_"))

## -----------------------------
## 2. Summary for type I error (delta0 = 1)
##    type I error = rejection rate at delta0 = 1
## -----------------------------
type1_summary <- data_long %>%
  filter(delta0 == 1) %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n) %>%
  summarise(
    type1 = mean(p_value < alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -----------------------------
## 3. Summary for power (all delta0)
##    power = rejection rate at each (delta0, n, method)
## -----------------------------
power_summary <- data_long %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n, delta0) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(p_value < alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -----------------------------
## 4. Plot functions for each (confounder, type) pair
## -----------------------------

# (a) Type I error plot:
#     x = sample size n, y = type I error, color = method
plot_type1_pair <- function(conf_level, type_level) {
  df <- type1_summary %>%
    filter(confounder == conf_level, type == type_level)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = type1, color = method, group = method)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = alpha, linetype = "dashed") + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Type I error (delta0 = 1)",
                    "\nconfounder =", conf_level,
                    ", type =", type_level),
      x = "Sample size n (n1 = n2)",
      y = "Type I error (rejection rate)",
      color = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

# (b) Power curves:
#     x = delta0, y = power, color = n (using your color palette),
#     facet by method
plot_power_pair <- function(conf_level, type_level) {
  df <- power_summary %>%
    filter(confounder == conf_level, type == type_level) %>%
    mutate(
      n_factor = factor(
        n,
        levels = as.numeric(names(n_colors)) # ensure order 10 < 30 < ...
      )
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = delta0, y = power,
                 color = n_factor, group = interaction(method, n))) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ method) +
    scale_color_manual(values = n_colors, name = "n") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Power vs delta0",
                    "\nconfounder =", conf_level,
                    ", type =", type_level),
      x = "delta0",
      y = "Power (rejection rate)"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

## -----------------------------
## 5. Generate plots for all (confounder, type) pairs
## -----------------------------
pairs_ct <- data %>%
  distinct(confounder, type)

# a list of Type I error plots
plots_type1 <- pmap(
  list(pairs_ct$confounder, pairs_ct$type),
  ~ plot_type1_pair(..1, ..2)
)

# a list of Power plots
plots_power <- pmap(
  list(pairs_ct$confounder, pairs_ct$type),
  ~ plot_power_pair(..1, ..2)
)

## Example: print the first pair's plots
# print(plots_type1[[1]])
# print(plots_power[[1]])

## -----------------------------
## 6. (Optional) Save all plots
## -----------------------------
```

```{r}
## =====================================================
## Combined Type I error ratio plots (median, sd, skew)
## confounder = "yes", ratio = type1 / ks_glm_overall
## Methods shown:
##   deshape              -> "DeSHAPE"               (#3c7fb1)
##   deshape_deconfounder -> "Deconfounder DeSHAPE"  (#e64532)
##   deshape_glm          -> "GLM DeSHAPE"           (#44a05c)
##   ks                   -> "KS"                    (#b53289)
## Baselines: 0.05 / ks_glm_overall, 0.10 / ks_glm_overall
## =====================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

alpha <- 0.05

## 1. Long format & Type I error summary (delta0 = 1)
data_long <- data %>%
  mutate(n = n1) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value), n <250) %>%
  mutate(
    method = str_remove(method, "^p_"),
    # for median, treat qr as deshape_deconfounder
    method = dplyr::if_else(
      type == "median" & method == "qr",
      "deshape_deconfounder",
      method
    )
  )

type1_summary <- data_long %>%
  filter(delta0 == 1) %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n) %>%
  summarise(
    type1 = mean(p_value < alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Methods of interest & pretty legend labels
method_keep <- c("deshape", "deshape_deconfounder", "ks")
method_labels <- c(
  "deshape"              = "DeSHAPE",
  "deshape_deconfounder" = "Deconfounder DeSHAPE",
  "deshape_glm"          = "GAMLSS DeSHAPE",
  "ks"                   = "KS"
)
method_colors <- c(
  "DeSHAPE"              = "#3c7fb1",
  "Deconfounder DeSHAPE" = "#e64532",
  "GAMLSS DeSHAPE"          = "#44a05c",
  "KS"                   = "#b53289"
)

## Helper to build ratio data for a given type
build_ratio_type <- function(type_name) {
  df_type <- type1_summary %>%
    filter(confounder == "yes", type == type_name)

  ks_glm_overall <- df_type %>%
    filter(method == "ks_glm") %>%
    summarise(val = mean(type1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(val)

  df_ratio <- df_type %>%
    mutate(ratio = type1 / ks_glm_overall)

  df_ratio_methods <- df_ratio %>%
    filter(method %in% method_keep) %>%
    mutate(
      method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
    )

  df_baseline <- df_ratio_methods %>%
    distinct(n) %>%
    mutate(
      ratio_005 = 0.05 / ks_glm_overall,
      ratio_010 = 0.10 / ks_glm_overall
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(ratio_005, ratio_010),
      names_to = "baseline",
      values_to = "ratio"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      baseline = recode(
        baseline,
        "ratio_005" = "0.05 / ks_glm",
        "ratio_010" = "0.10 / ks_glm"
      )
    )

  df_line <- df_ratio_methods %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    filter(dplyr::n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()

  list(
    ratio_methods = df_ratio_methods,
    baseline_long = df_baseline,
    line_methods  = df_line
  )
}

## 2. Build data for median, sd, skew
rat_median <- build_ratio_type("median")
rat_sd     <- build_ratio_type("sd")
rat_skew   <- build_ratio_type("skew")

## Global y max for consistent y-axis
y_max_median <- max(
  rat_median$ratio_methods$ratio,
  rat_median$baseline_long$ratio,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_max_sd <- max(
  rat_sd$ratio_methods$ratio,
  rat_sd$baseline_long$ratio,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

y_max_skew <- max(
  rat_skew$ratio_methods$ratio,
  rat_skew$baseline_long$ratio,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


## 3. One plot per type (same style)

p_median <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey40", size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_median$line_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method, group = method),
    size = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = rat_median$ratio_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method),
    size = 2.5, stroke = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_median$baseline_long,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, linetype = baseline, group = baseline),
    color = "black", size = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("0.05 / ks_glm" = "dashed",
               "0.10 / ks_glm" = "dashed"),
    name = "Baseline"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median shift",
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Type I error ratio"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max_median * 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", size = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p_sd <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey40", size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_sd$line_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method, group = method),
    size = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = rat_sd$ratio_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method),
    size = 2.5, stroke = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_sd$baseline_long,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, linetype = baseline, group = baseline),
    color = "black", size = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("0.05 / ks_glm" = "dashed",
               "0.10 / ks_glm" = "dashed"),
    name = "Baseline"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dispersion shift",
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Type I error ratio"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max_sd * 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", size = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p_skew <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey40", size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_skew$line_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method, group = method),
    size = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = rat_skew$ratio_methods,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, color = method),
    size = 2.5, stroke = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = rat_skew$baseline_long,
    aes(x = n, y = ratio, linetype = baseline, group = baseline),
    color = "black", size = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("0.05 / ks_glm" = "dashed",
               "0.10 / ks_glm" = "dashed"),
    name = "Baseline"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Skewness shift",
    x = "Sample Size",
    y = "Type I error ratio"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max_skew * 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", size = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## 4. Combine into a 3×1 figure with one legend
p_median <- p_median + guides(color = "none", linetype = "none")
p_sd     <- p_sd     + guides(color = "none", linetype = "none")
p_skew <- p_skew +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "horizontal",   # Method & Baseline side-by-side
    legend.box.just = "center"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "Method",
      nrow  = 2,          # Method items can wrap to 2 rows
      byrow = TRUE
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      title = "Baseline",
      nrow  = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )

combined_type1 <- (p_median / p_sd / p_skew) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1)

combined_type1
ggsave(
  filename = "Type1_ratio_combined.png",
  plot     = combined_type1,
  width    = 10,      # you can tweak
  height   = 10,       # you can tweak
  dpi      = 600      # high resolution
)
```




```{r}
## =====================================================
## Type I error (original scale) plots (median, sd, skew)
## confounder = "yes", delta0 = 1
## Smoothed curves are CLAMPED to [0, 1] so min=0 and max=1
## =====================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

alpha <- 0.05

## 1) Long format
data_long <- data %>%
  mutate(n = n1) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value), n < 250) %>%
  mutate(
    method = str_remove(method, "^p_"),
    # for median, treat qr as deshape_deconfounder
    method = dplyr::if_else(type == "median" & method == "qr",
                            "deshape_deconfounder", method)
  )

## 2) Type I error summary (delta0 = 1)
type1_summary <- data_long %>%
  filter(delta0 == 1) %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n) %>%
  summarise(
    type1 = mean(p_value < alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## 3) Methods & aesthetics
method_keep <- c("deshape", "deshape_deconfounder", "ks")

method_labels <- c(
  "deshape"              = "DeSHAPE",
  "deshape_deconfounder" = "Deconfounder DeSHAPE",
  "deshape_glm"          = "GAMLSS DeSHAPE",
  "ks"                   = "KS"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "DeSHAPE"              = "#3c7fb1",
  "Deconfounder DeSHAPE" = "#e64532",
  "GAMLSS DeSHAPE"       = "#44a05c",
  "KS"                   = "#b53289"
)

baseline_df <- tibble(
  baseline = factor(c("0.05", "0.10"), levels = c("0.05", "0.10")),
  y        = c(0.05, 0.10)
)

## ---- Smoothed curve builder (per method), CLAMP to [0,1] ----
make_smooth_df <- function(df, n_grid = 200, loess_span = 0.75) {
  rng <- range(df$n, na.rm = TRUE)
  grid_n <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = n_grid)

  df %>%
    arrange(n) %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      # if too few points for loess, fall back to linear
      if (nrow(d) >= 4 && length(unique(d$n)) >= 4) {
        fit <- tryCatch(
          loess(type1 ~ n, data = d, span = loess_span,
                control = loess.control(surface = "direct")),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (is.null(fit)) {
          fit <- lm(type1 ~ n, data = d)
          yhat <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(n = grid_n))
        } else {
          yhat <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(n = grid_n))
        }
      } else {
        fit <- lm(type1 ~ n, data = d)
        yhat <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(n = grid_n))
      }

      # CLAMP to [0,1]
      yhat <- pmax(0, pmin(1, yhat))

      tibble(n = grid_n, type1_smooth = yhat)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

## Plot builder (original scale, smoothed curves, y-limits start at 0)
plot_type1 <- function(type_name, title_text) {

  df <- type1_summary %>%
    filter(confounder == "yes", type == type_name, method %in% method_keep) %>%
    mutate(
      method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
    )

  df_smooth <- make_smooth_df(df, n_grid = 200, loess_span = 0.75)

  # y-limit: start at 0, include baseline(0.10); upper cap only at 1
  y_max <- max(c(df$type1, 0.10), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- c(0, min(1, y_max * 1.10))

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(
      data = baseline_df,
      aes(yintercept = y, linetype = baseline),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = df_smooth,
      aes(x = n, y = type1_smooth, color = method, group = method),
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, name = "Method") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("0.05" = "dashed", "0.10" = "dotted"),
      name   = "Baseline"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Sample size",
      y = "Type I error"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

p_median <- plot_type1("median", "Median shift")
p_sd     <- plot_type1("sd",     "Dispersion shift")
p_skew   <- plot_type1("skew",   "Skewness shift")

combined_type1 <-
  (p_median / p_sd / p_skew) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center"
  )

combined_type1

ggsave(
  filename = "Type1_originalscale.png",
  plot     = combined_type1,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 10,
  dpi      = 1000
)

```







```{r}
## ============================================
## POWER FIGURES: median, sd, skew (no confounder)
## - median, sd: effectsize based on delta0 (your transforms)
## - skew: effectsize = 2/sqrt(alpha1) - 2/sqrt(alpha1 * delta0)
## - sd & skew: remove ttest, wilcox from curves (but keep in legend)
## - Panels: 3×1, shared legend at bottom
## ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(mFilter)
library(patchwork)

alpha  <- 0.05
alpha1 <- 2   # <-- set to your actual simulation alpha1

## -----------------------------
## 1. Long format & power summary
## -----------------------------
data_long_power <- data %>%
  mutate(n = n1) %>%              # n1 = n2
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(method = str_remove(method, "^p_"))

power_summary <- data_long_power %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n, delta0) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(p_value < alpha),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -----------------------------
## 2. Formal method names & palette
## -----------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "deshape"              = "DeSHAPE",
  "ks"                   = "KS test",
  "ttest"                = "t test",
  "wilcox"               = "Wilcoxon test"
)

method_levels <- unname(method_labels)

method_palette <- c(
  "DeSHAPE"               = "#3c7fb1",
  "KS test"               = "#e64532",
  "t test"                = "#44a05c",
  "Wilcoxon test"         = "#b53289"
)
labeller_n <- labeller(
  n_factor = function(x) paste0("n = ", x)
)
## ============================================
## 3. type = "median"  (no confounder)
##    - effectsize = delta0 - 1 (es_plot), truncated < 3
##    - spline interpolation smoothing
## ============================================

power_median <- power_summary %>%
  filter(
    confounder == "no",
    type == "median",
    n %in% c(10, 30, 50, 70)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effectsize = delta0
  )

power_median$n_factor <- factor(
  power_median$n,
  levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70)
)

power_median_smooth <- power_median %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  distinct(effectsize, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # 防止 effectsize 重复
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power

    if (length(x) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(effectsize = x, power = y))
    }

    x_new <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 200)
    f     <- splinefun(x, y, method = "fmm")

    y_new <- f(x_new)
    y_new <- pmin(pmax(y_new, 0), 1)  # 截断在 [0,1]

    data.frame(effectsize = x_new, power = y_new)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    es_plot = effectsize - 1       # 你的横轴变换
  ) %>%
  filter(es_plot < 2)              # 截断范围

power_median_smooth$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_median_smooth$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

p_median <- ggplot(
  power_median_smooth,
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power,
      color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Median shift",
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Power"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 4. type = "sd"  (no confounder)
##    - effectsize = delta0, x_plot = 2*(effectsize - 1)
##    - remove ttest, wilcox from curves
##    - HP filter for trend
## ============================================

power_sd <- power_summary %>%
  filter(
    confounder == "no",
    type == "sd",
    n %in% c(10, 30, 50, 70)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effectsize = delta0
  )

power_sd$n_factor <- factor(
  power_sd$n,
  levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70)
)

power_sd_filt <- power_sd %>%
  filter(!method %in% c("ttest", "wilcox"))

power_sd_hp <- power_sd_filt %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power

    if (length(y) < 3) {
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = y)
    } else {
      hp     <- mFilter::hpfilter(y, freq = 100)
      trend  <- as.numeric(hp$trend)
      trend  <- pmin(pmax(trend, 0), 1)

      data.frame(effectsize = x,
                 power_trend = trend)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    es_plot = 2 * (effectsize - 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(es_plot < 15)

power_sd_hp$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_sd_hp$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

p_sd <- ggplot(
  power_sd_hp,
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power_trend,
      color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Dispersion shift",
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Power"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 5. type = "skew"  (no confounder)
##    - effectsize = 2/sqrt(alpha1) - 2/sqrt(alpha1 * delta0)
##    - remove ttest, wilcox from curves
##    - HP filter for trend
## ============================================

power_skew <- power_summary %>%
  filter(
    confounder == "no",
    type == "skew",
    n %in% c(90, 230, 330, 410)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effectsize = delta0#2 / sqrt(1/16) - 2 / sqrt(1/16 * delta0)
  )

power_skew$n_factor <- factor(
  power_skew$n,
  levels = c(90, 230, 330, 410)
)

power_skew_filt <- power_skew %>%
  filter(!method %in% c("ttest", "wilcox"))

power_skew_hp <- power_skew_filt %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power

    if (length(y) < 3) {
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = y)
    } else {
      hp     <- mFilter::hpfilter(y, freq = 100)
      trend  <- as.numeric(hp$trend)
      trend  <- pmin(pmax(trend, 0), 1)

      data.frame(effectsize = x,
                 power_trend = trend)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    es_plot = effectsize
  )

power_skew_hp$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_skew_hp$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

p_skew <- ggplot(
  power_skew_hp,
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power_trend,
      color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Skewness shift",
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Power"
  ) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 6. Combine into 3×1 figure with single legend
## ============================================

## 1) Turn off legends in all three panels
p_median <- p_median + guides(color = "none")
p_sd     <- p_sd     + guides(color = "none")
p_skew   <- p_skew   + guides(color = "none")

## 2) Custom legend with ONLY the 4 methods (formal names + colors)
legend_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(
    c("DeSHAPE",
      "KS test",
      "t test",
      "Wilcoxon test"),
    levels = c("DeSHAPE",
               "KS test",
               "t test",
               "Wilcoxon test")
  ),
  x = 1,
  y = 1
)

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  # draw real points so legend is correct
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = method_palette,
    name   = "Method"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "Method",
      nrow  = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  # move point outside visible region so it’s clipped
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.5), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "on") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.margin   = margin(t = -6, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = -15, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
  )

## 3) Combine 3 panels + custom legend
combined_power <- (p_median / p_sd / p_skew / legend_plot) +
  plot_layout(
    ncol    = 1,
    heights = c(3, 3, 3, 0.5)   # relative heights: 3 panels + 1 legend row
  )

print(combined_power)

ggsave(
  filename = "Power_combined_median_sd_skew.png",
  plot     = combined_power,
  width    = 12,
  height   = 10,
  dpi      = 600
)


```

```{r}
## ============================================
## POWER FIGURES: median, sd, skew (no confounder)
## Truncation requirement = the *panel x-axis* must end there (no extra empty x-range).
## Implemented via:
##   1) facet_wrap(scales = "free_x")
##   2) geom_blank() to force each facet range to [0, max_trunc] exactly
##   3) scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) to remove padding
## ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(mFilter)
library(patchwork)

alpha  <- 0.05
alpha1 <- 2

## -----------------------------
## 1. Long format & power summary
## -----------------------------
data_long_power <- data %>%
  mutate(n = n1) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to  = "method",
    values_to = "p_value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(method = str_remove(method, "^p_"))

power_summary <- data_long_power %>%
  group_by(confounder, type, method, n, delta0) %>%
  summarise(power = mean(p_value < alpha), .groups = "drop")

## -----------------------------
## 2. Formal method names & palette
## -----------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "deshape" = "DeSHAPE",
  "ks"      = "KS test",
  "ttest"   = "t test",
  "wilcox"  = "Wilcoxon test"
)
method_levels <- unname(method_labels)

method_palette <- c(
  "DeSHAPE"        = "#3c7fb1",
  "KS test"        = "#e64532",
  "t test"         = "#44a05c",
  "Wilcoxon test"  = "#b53289"
)

labeller_n <- labeller(n_factor = function(x) paste0("n = ", x))

## ============================================
## 3. Median shift (spline smoothing + facet-specific truncation)
##   x = es_plot = delta0 - 1
##   trunc: n=30 -> 1.1, n=50 -> 1.0, n=70 -> 0.8, n=10 keep 2.0
## ============================================

power_median <- power_summary %>%
  filter(confounder == "no", type == "median", n %in% c(10, 30, 50, 70)) %>%
  mutate(effectsize = delta0)

power_median$n_factor <- factor(power_median$n, levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70))

power_median_smooth <- power_median %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  distinct(effectsize, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power
    if (length(x) < 2) {
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power = y)
    } else {
      x_new <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 200)
      f <- splinefun(x, y, method = "fmm")
      y_new <- pmin(pmax(f(x_new), 0), 1)
      data.frame(effectsize = x_new, power = y_new)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(es_plot = effectsize - 1)

power_median_smooth$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_median_smooth$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

## Force per-facet x-range to start at 0 and end at the requested truncation
median_xlim <- tibble(
  n_factor = factor(c(10, 30, 50, 70), levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70)),
  x_min    = 0,
  x_max    = c(2.0, 1.1, 0.8, 0.8)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(x_min, x_max), names_to = "which", values_to = "es_plot")

p_median <- ggplot(
  power_median_smooth %>%
    filter(es_plot >= 0) %>%   # keep clean left bound
    filter(es_plot <= case_when(
      n_factor == "10" ~ 2.0,
      n_factor == "30" ~ 1.1,
      n_factor == "50" ~ 1.0,
      n_factor == "70" ~ 0.8
    )),
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power, color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_blank(data = median_xlim, aes(x = es_plot, y = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(title = "Median shift", x = "Effect size", y = "Power") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 4. Dispersion shift (HP trend + facet-specific truncation)
##   x = es_plot = 2*(delta0 - 1)
##   trunc: n=30 -> 10, n=50 -> 5, n=70 -> 4, n=10 keep 15
##   (curves shown only for DeSHAPE + KS, but legend keeps all four)
## ============================================

power_sd <- power_summary %>%
  filter(confounder == "no", type == "sd", n %in% c(10, 30, 50, 70)) %>%
  mutate(effectsize = delta0)

power_sd$n_factor <- factor(power_sd$n, levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70))

power_sd_filt <- power_sd %>%
  filter(!method %in% c("ttest", "wilcox"))

power_sd_hp <- power_sd_filt %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power
    if (length(y) < 3) {
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = y)
    } else {
      hp <- mFilter::hpfilter(y, freq = 100)
      trend <- pmin(pmax(as.numeric(hp$trend), 0), 1)
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = trend)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(es_plot = 2 * (effectsize - 1))

power_sd_hp$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_sd_hp$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

sd_xlim <- tibble(
  n_factor = factor(c(10, 30, 50, 70), levels = c(10, 30, 50, 70)),
  x_min    = 0,
  x_max    = c(15, 10, 5, 4)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(x_min, x_max), names_to = "which", values_to = "es_plot")

p_sd <- ggplot(
  power_sd_hp %>%
    filter(es_plot >= 0) %>%
    filter(es_plot <= case_when(
      n_factor == "10" ~ 15,
      n_factor == "30" ~ 10,
      n_factor == "50" ~ 5,
      n_factor == "70" ~ 4
    )),
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power_trend, color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_blank(data = sd_xlim, aes(x = es_plot, y = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(title = "Dispersion shift", x = "Effect size", y = "Power") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 5. Skewness shift (UNCHANGED)
## ============================================

power_skew <- power_summary %>%
  filter(confounder == "no", type == "skew", n %in% c(90, 230, 330, 410)) %>%
  mutate(effectsize = delta0)

power_skew$n_factor <- factor(power_skew$n, levels = c(90, 230, 330, 410))

power_skew_filt <- power_skew %>%
  filter(!method %in% c("ttest", "wilcox"))

power_skew_hp <- power_skew_filt %>%
  group_by(n_factor, method) %>%
  arrange(effectsize) %>%
  do({
    x <- .$effectsize
    y <- .$power
    if (length(y) < 3) {
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = y)
    } else {
      hp <- mFilter::hpfilter(y, freq = 100)
      trend <- pmin(pmax(as.numeric(hp$trend), 0), 1)
      data.frame(effectsize = x, power_trend = trend)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(es_plot = effectsize)

power_skew_hp$Method <- factor(
  recode(power_skew_hp$method, !!!method_labels),
  levels = method_levels
)

p_skew <- ggplot(
  power_skew_hp,
  aes(x = es_plot, y = power_trend, color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n_factor, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller_n) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Skewness shift", x = "Effect size", y = "Power") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 11)
  )

## ============================================
## 6. Shared legend (custom), combine 3×1
## ============================================

p_median <- p_median + guides(color = "none")
p_sd     <- p_sd     + guides(color = "none")
p_skew   <- p_skew   + guides(color = "none")

legend_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(
    c("DeSHAPE", "KS test", "t test", "Wilcoxon test"),
    levels = c("DeSHAPE", "KS test", "t test", "Wilcoxon test")
  ),
  x = 1, y = 1
)

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_palette, name = "Method") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Method", nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.5), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "on") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box      = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.margin   = margin(t = -6, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = -15, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
  )

combined_power <- (p_median / p_sd / p_skew / legend_plot) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(3, 3, 3, 0.5))

print(combined_power)

ggsave(
  filename = "Power_combined_median_sd_skew_truncated.png",
  plot     = combined_power,
  width    = 12,
  height   = 10,
  dpi      = 600
)

```
